title: fall detection
task: Wrist accelerometer: 6 features of a 4 s window -> fall yes/no.
signal: 6 accelerometer window features (5-bit signed: peak, jerk, tilt change, free-fall, stillness, step regularity); a fall shifts all six together, 25 % of non-falls are hard sit-downs with a high peak and jerk only; unit-variance noise x 3.
model_size: layers [6, 12, 1], 84 weights (ternary hidden, 5-bit output layer); input 6 lanes x 5-bit signed
data: Synthetic data from a seeded generator, not patient data; the detection figures are on synthetic test windows and make no clinical claim.
